origin: Sun center; parent-relative vectors identify their parent separately
angular_input_frame: ICRS catalog axes treated as J2000 equatorial at atlas precision
icrs_frame_bias_note: Sub-arcsecond ICRS/J2000 frame bias is not modeled; this is an atlas projection, not apparent astrometry.
proper_motion_model: normalized tangent vector at fixed distance; no radial perspective acceleration
missing_motion: retain catalog direction and source epoch; never impute zero proper motion
legacy: Existing immutable releases retain their declared frame and epoch. Never relabel or overwrite a legacy artifact; rebuild into a distinct release before publication.
